players.product: Faraday rotator plates, optical crystals (incl. TSAG magneto-optical crystals) and precision optics (crystal growth, precision optical processing, coating, device integration)

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results (half-year report): revenue RMB 723,896,107.75, up 39.46% YoY, which the company attributes mainly to downstream demand growth lifting shipments; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 180,644,841.06, up 40.97%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 164,687,358.59, up 37.42%; operating cash flow RMB 287,557,121.86, up 112.33%. Gross margin 49.42%, down 1.55 points: operating cost rose 43.87%, faster than revenue, mainly because selling prices of some products fell and material and labour costs rose.

Products and regions (half-year report, H1 2026): precision optical components RMB 312,723,712.52, up 71.82%, 43.20% of revenue, gross margin 47.55% (up 6.29 points) - the company says demand in laser, optical-communications and ultra-precision optics markets expanded quickly and order volume rose sharply; nonlinear optical crystal components RMB 166,090,816.23, up 31.29%, gross margin 72.55%; laser crystal components RMB 101,642,219.05, up 13.37%, gross margin 52.92%; laser devices RMB 109,280,608.52, down 2.05%, gross margin 23.30%, hit by phased demand adjustments in some sub-markets and more homogeneous competition. Domestic revenue RMB 509,972,395.70, up 54.96% (70.45% of revenue); export revenue RMB 213,923,712.05, up 12.62%.

Balance sheet signals of capacity build-out and demand (half-year report, end of June 2026): construction in progress RMB 204,939,434.13, up 79.23%, mainly equipment awaiting installation and the Phase II Building D project; Building D balance RMB 109,845,842.88, cumulative spend at 38.65% of its RMB 284,204,000.00 budget; fixed assets RMB 1,024,520,733.56, up 35.97%, mainly from added precious-metal crucibles; contract liabilities RMB 93,174,212.22, up 617.16%, mainly from increased advance payments for goods.

Subsidiaries (half-year report, H1 2026): Zhiqi Photonics revenue RMB 13,914.18 ten-thousand, up 183.65%, net profit RMB 3,589.12 ten-thousand, up 3506.40%; Ruichuang Optoelectronics revenue RMB 2,491.53 ten-thousand, up 56.42%, net profit RMB 1,021.19 ten-thousand, up 112.54%; Qingdao Haitai Optoelectronics revenue RMB 7,204.96 ten-thousand, down 6.47%, net profit RMB 1,536.26 ten-thousand, down 46.02% on lower prices for some products, higher costs and credit impairment provisions.
quarterly_data.figure: Zhiqi Photonics H1 revenue RMB 13,914.18 ten-thousand (+183.65%)

quarterly_data.signal: R&D and products (half-year report): H1 2026 R&D spending RMB 54,503,502.33, up 1.08%. The company developed and launched a 32-channel acousto-optic modulator for high-end parallel light-modulation applications.

Receivables concentration (half-year report notes; a share of receivables, not of sales): the five largest debtors held RMB 178,271,368.43, 33.11% of receivables and contract assets at end of June 2026, the largest 12.27% (RMB 66,064,219.74); names not disclosed.
